# Sample generated SQL

Auto-generated from `scripts/show_sample_sql.py` against the three
example DataModels in [DATA_MODEL_FORMAT.md](DATA_MODEL_FORMAT.md).
Schema name and project UUID are fixed placeholders so re-running
the script produces byte-stable output (modulo the embedded
generation timestamp). Refresh after any change to
`app/services/tenant_sql_generator.py`:

```bash
docker exec lucid-ai-ai_engine-1 python scripts/show_sample_sql.py \
    > docs/SAMPLE_GENERATED_SQL.md
```
